cards.card_text: Then at Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost, Saul will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, prophesying.
cards.verse_text: As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
cards.snippet: …place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.

cards.card_text: When Saul finishes prophesying, he goes up to the high place.
cards.verse_text: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
cards.snippet: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.

cards.card_text: He walks along prophesying He turns back toward home He hurries ahead with his spear
cards.verse_text: But the Spirit of God came upon even Saul, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

cards.card_text: Dressed in royal attire, Ahab and Jehoshaphat sit on their thrones at the threshing floor by the gate of Samaria, Israel's capital, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
cards.verse_text: Dressed in royal attire, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
cards.snippet: …by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

cards.card_text: And all the prophets are prophesying the same: go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.
cards.verse_text: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

cards.card_text: The Jewish elders build and prosper through the prophesying of two prophets.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD turns to the exiles and names two men prophesying lies to them in His name: Ahab son of Kolaiah (not King Ahab) and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah (not King Zedekiah).
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you lies in My name: “I will deliver them to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your very eyes.

cards.card_text: Ezekiel is still prophesying when something happens to Pelatiah son of Benaiah, one of the two men named at the gate.
cards.verse_text: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died.
cards.snippet: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died.
